name: openclaude
readme_excerpt: OpenClaude is an open-source coding-agent CLI for cloud and local model providers. Use OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, GitHub Models, Codex OAuth, Codex, Ollama, Atomic Chat, and other supported backends while keeping one terminal-first workflow: prompts, tools, agents, MCP, slash commands, and streaming output.
